name: devtools
description: Developer tooling monorepo providing development utilities and workflows across CLI, daemon, API, and frontend interfaces.
author: Ahmed Hanye

scripts.build:smoke: bun run build:bin && bun run smoke:bin
scripts.react-doctor: bun run react-doctor:code && bun run react-doctor:design
scripts.verify:workflows: bun -e 'import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process"; const ok = ["actionlint", "zizmor", "shellcheck"].every((c) => spawnSync("which", [c]).status === 0); if (ok || process.env.CI) { process.exit(spawnSync("bun", ["run", "lint:workflows"], { stdio: "inherit" }).status ?? 1); } console.log("Warning: skipping lint:workflows (actionlint, zizmor, or shellcheck missing from PATH)");'
scripts.verify:fast: bun run check && bun run typecheck && bun run fallow:dead-code && bun run fallow:arch && bun run fallow:health && bun run lint:agents && bun run verify:db-migrations && bun --filter @devtools/frontend test
scripts.verify: bun run check && bun run typecheck && bun run fallow:dead-code && bun run fallow:arch && bun run fallow:health && bun run lint:agents && bun run lint:fsd && bun run fallow:dupes && bun run react-doctor && bun run verify:db-migrations && bun --filter @devtools/frontend build && bun run test:coverage && bun run verify:diff-coverage && bun run audit && bun run smoke:bin && bun run verify:workflows
